notes: Adds missing security hardening, observability, and failure-mode handling stories for server-side enforcement.

GPTR-F-001-S57.title: Allowlist Configuration Schema and Loader
GPTR-F-001-S57.description: Define structured allowlist configuration (collections, fields, operators) and implement secure loader with validation at startup to prevent malformed or permissive configs.

GPTR-F-001-S58.title: Rejection Handling and Error Response Contract
GPTR-F-001-S58.description: Standardize error responses for rejected requests including reason codes (schema violation, allowlist violation, limit exceeded) without leaking internal structure or sensitive details.

GPTR-F-001-S59.title: Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
GPTR-F-001-S59.description: Log all enforcement decisions (pass/fail, rule triggered, request metadata) to support auditability and security review without storing sensitive payload data.

GPTR-F-001-S60.title: Edge Case Handling for Nested and Complex Queries
GPTR-F-001-S60.description: Extend enforcement engine to safely evaluate nested filters, logical operators, and projection edge cases to prevent bypass via complex query structures.
